description:
Share a finished Short form run as a public, read-only page anyone can open with the
    link, no sign-in: each hook's spoken line, on-screen words, idea, plays, creator and its
    video, in the Hook Detector skill page layout. Nothing about the account is on it.

    Returns {"run_id", "token", "url"}; give the person the url
    (https://hookdetector.com/p/<token>). Idempotent: a run keeps one link, so calling again
    returns the same url. The same body as POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/share; the page's data is
    GET /v1/shared/{token}, no key needed. Needs the write scope. Free.
    Errors: 404 run_not_found, 409 run_not_finished while the run works (call get_run with
    wait_seconds=50 first), 409 run_not_shareable for a failed run or a Long form or
    Packaging run, 422 invalid_request for a malformed run_id.
name: share_run
